summary: A concise prompt used with Opus 5.5 to generate a 30-second brand pitch video.

post.originalText:
So I wanted to try out opus 5.5 for Video generation.

I gave it a single sentence prompt:

„Create a 30sec pitch video for @chaindotwtf “

The only reference I gave it was website, logo and the context it had from previous chats. Nothing else.

This is what it came up with. Wow https://t.co/3QN0TQnkZA
